A Kerala landmark described as the world's largest bird sculpture depicts Jatayu the Ramayana figure who risked his life to save Sita despite knowing he could never defeat Ravana according to The Times of India. The article notes the structure's age as 60,000 years.

NDTV reported the Jatayu versus Ravan scene comparing it to Thor's entry in Wakanda which prompted netizens to go gaga over the depiction. The coverage frames the ancient episode through a modern cinematic lens.

The source circulates via Google News and references NDTV Profit alongside the Times of India report on the Kerala bird sculpture.
